basic_details.job_title: CONCOR General Manager/ Senior General Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 56 years as on closing date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: IRTS | The Officer should have practical experience in marketing, commercial & operational activities.

salary_details.details: As per extant Govt. Directive, the officer will draw the salary of the parent department plus deputation allowance. Allowances & Perks will be payable as per the entitlement of the Officer.

selection_process: The candidate will be screened by a Screening Committee as nominated by the Competent Authority. The candidate's suitability will be decided
keeping in view the job requirement. The selection process would comprise of judgement of different facets of Professional Ability
aptitude etc on a 100-point scale as under:
Professional Ability: 30 Marks Experience: 20 Marks Seniority: 20 Marks APAR: 30 Marks
how_to_apply: Ensure eligibility as per the notification criteria.
Fill out the prescribed proforma application form (Annexure-II) with all required personal and professional details.
Attach a self-attested passport-size photograph to the application.
Enclose all relevant proofs and documents in support of qualification, experience, and pay scale/gross salary.
Send the application through the respective administrative officer (Board/HQ) along with No-objection, Vigilance/D&AR clearance, and ACR for the past 05 years.
Alternatively, send an advance copy of the application enclosing all relevant proof and documents superscribing the cover prominently with "Name of the Post".

Submit the application by post or email latest by 08.11.2026 to the designated address or email ID: Area Head (Area-II), Container Corporation of India Ltd, NSIC MDBP Building, 3rd Floor, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi 110076. Email: [email protected].
important_instructions: Cut-off date for age and eligibility would be reckoned as on the closing date of the vacancy notice. Tenure is 03 years, extendable up to 02 years as per GOI rules. Candidates must remain in constant touch with the official website for updates. Applications sent without administrative clearance, No-objection, Vigilance/D&AR clearance, or past ACRs may be submitted as an advance copy, but complete official channels must be followed.

The selection process would comprise of judgement of different facets of Professional Ability, Experience, skills, comprehension, aptitude etc on a 100-point scale as under: Professional Ability: 30 Marks Experience: 20 Marks Seniority: 20 Marks APAR: 30 Marks

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Ensure eligibility as per the notification criteria. Fill out the prescribed proforma application form (Annexure-II) with all required personal and professional details. Attach a self-attested passport-size photograph to the application. Enclose all relevant proofs and documents in support of qualification, experience, and pay scale/gross salary. Send the application through the respective administrative officer (Board/HQ) along with No-objection, Vigilance/D&AR clearance, and ACR for the past 05 years. Alternatively, send an advance copy of the application enclosing all relevant proof and documents superscribing the cover prominently with "Name of the Post". Submit the application by post or email latest by 08.11.2026 to the designated address or email ID: Area Head (Area-II), Container Corporation of India Ltd, NSIC MDBP Building, 3rd Floor, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi 110076. Email: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CONCOR Recruitment 2026 is a deputation notification released to fill 1 vacancy for the General Manager/C&O / Senior General Manager/C&O post under the IRTS cadre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 08.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CONCOR General Manager/C&O?
faq.answer: Applicants must be SG Officers or JAG/SG Officers of the IRTS cadre meeting specific Group 'A' service duration requirements and possessing practical experience in marketing, commercial, and operational activities.

faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.
